acceptanceCriteria: SRG-V0-011 states a deterministic ordering or merge rule for the header tail.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1468 (tasksup-1021m, seal 0515bf47b). Main and the lane both appended to the ATR status lines in docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md; SRG-V0-011 does not say how the header tail is ordered or merged, so parallel lanes conflict and reviewers cannot tell which form is correct.
title: SRG-V0-011 header-tail rule is ambiguous when two changes append to the same spec status lines
